G4252.name: Priscilla
G4252.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G4252.brief: Early Christian teacher; wife of Aquila
G4252.short: Priscilla, also known as Prisca, was a Jewish Christian and the wife of Aquila, who worked with Paul in his ministry and hosted a church in their home.

G4227.name: Pudens
G4227.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G4227.brief: Christian in Rome who greeted Timothy
G4227.short: Pudens, a Christian in Rome who sent greetings to Timothy through Paul's letter.

G4223.name: Puteoli
G4223.brief: A port city in Italy visited by Paul
G4223.short: Puteoli was a major port city in Italy where Paul stayed for seven days on his journey to Rome as a prisoner.
